description:
Hushfacebook v0.14.0 targets Facebook 583.0.0.39.55 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

This release moves Hushfacebook to Facebook 583.0.0.39.55. There are new patches to skip the quiet stretches in videos and to post Stories in HD, plus switches that put the tab bar back at the top, keep a reel's original sound instead of a Meta AI dub, give tablets the phone layout and hide the Meta AI shortcut in the Menu. Picture-in-picture got a round of fixes, and dark mode with Material You shouldn't crash Facebook on Android 12 and newer anymore.

This release has 91 patches. Built by GitHub Actions from commit 646d8ce8caea, with build provenance attested. The patches weren't applied to a Facebook APK in CI.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 583.0.0.39.55, build 475614366, or its 32-bit build 475614365. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
